## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass with strict dependency verification.
- [ ] Release lint and assembly pass.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has test coverage.
- [ ] Screenshots and fixtures contain synthetic identifiers only.

List the commands, devices, or other evidence used to validate the change.

## Privacy, permissions, and safety

- [ ] No signing material, credentials, machine-specific paths, private captures, or raw network identifiers are included.
- [ ] Permission, network-access, exported-component, storage, and logging changes are described below.
- [ ] The passive product boundary remains intact, or an ADR explicitly proposes the boundary change.

Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing documentation and ADRs are updated where needed.
